name: Beijing Yupont Electric Power Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing Yupont Electric Power Technology Co., Ltd. is a Chinese enterprise that specializes in the comprehensive lifecycle of electric energy measurement solutions. This encompasses the development, manufacturing, and distribution of a wide array of advanced power metering devices for the domestic market. Their product portfolio includes sophisticated single-phase and three-phase smart meters, data concentrators, collectors, specialized terminals for transformers and distribution network automation, fault indicators, and data acquisition units, all supported by their proprietary master station systems and associated software. Beyond core metering hardware, Yupont extends its expertise to offer a suite of integrated services. These include robust power grid information platforms, comprehensive energy internet systems, advanced analysis systems for helicopter-borne LiDAR scanning data on transmission lines, laser scanning technology applied to digital city infrastructure, and tailored solutions for power plants. The company primarily caters to major power grid operators and large-scale power generation enterprises. Established in 1996 and headquartered in Beijing, China, Yupont has a strong domestic presence in the energy sector.
